## About

Sagar Roka Chhetri is a final-year Computer Engineering student at Cosmos College of Management & Technology (Pokhara University), graduating 2026. He has two years of independent project experience and currently works as a Full Stack Developer at CodeRunners Technologies on a live MERN stack platform.
